survey: A cylindrical stage light faces down and toward the camera, with three recessed round lenses in its front plate. A U-shaped mounting yoke wraps over the housing and attaches at side pivots; the near pivot is visible and the far one is obscured. A curved connector joins the yoke to a clamp on the overhead truss. A short housing projects underneath the rear of the light. The truss tubes connect through diagonal braces, and the light beams originate at the lenses.
